name: mgl-video
description: Promo video for My Gift Lockers (Remotion). Kept outside the pnpm workspace so production builds never install it.

scripts.music: node scripts/music.mjs out/music.wav && remotion ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/music.wav -c:a aac -b:a 192k -f mp4 public/music.m4a
scripts.render:en: remotion render Landscape out/my-gift-lockers-16x9.mp4 && remotion render Vertical out/my-gift-lockers-9x16.mp4
scripts.render:es: remotion render LandscapeES out/my-gift-lockers-es-16x9.mp4 && remotion render VerticalES out/my-gift-lockers-es-9x16.mp4
scripts.render:web: remotion ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/my-gift-lockers-16x9.mp4 -vf scale=1280:720:flags=lanczos -c:v libx264 -crf 25 -preset slow -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a aac -b:a 128k -movflags +faststart ../apps/web/public/video/tour-en-16x9.mp4 && remotion ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/my-gift-lockers-9x16.mp4 -vf scale=720:1280:flags=lanczos -c:v libx264 -crf 25 -preset slow -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a aac -b:a 128k -movflags +faststart ../apps/web/public/video/tour-en-9x16.mp4 && remotion ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/my-gift-lockers-es-16x9.mp4 -vf scale=1280:720:flags=lanczos -c:v libx264 -crf 25 -preset slow -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a aac -b:a 128k -movflags +faststart ../apps/web/public/video/tour-es-16x9.mp4 && remotion ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/my-gift-lockers-es-9x16.mp4 -vf scale=720:1280:flags=lanczos -c:v libx264 -crf 25 -preset slow -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a aac -b:a 128k -movflags +faststart ../apps/web/public/video/tour-es-9x16.mp4 && remotion still Landscape ../apps/web/public/video/tour-en-16x9.jpg --frame=190 --jpeg-quality=80 && remotion still Vertical ../apps/web/public/video/tour-en-9x16.jpg --frame=190 --jpeg-quality=80 && remotion still LandscapeES ../apps/web/public/video/tour-es-16x9.jpg --frame=190 --jpeg-quality=80 && remotion still VerticalES ../apps/web/public/video/tour-es-9x16.jpg --frame=190 --jpeg-quality=80 && remotion ffmpeg -y
